title: Payday 3 Weapon Bench
credits: Made by Jade 🌺 ✦ Skill Icons by Sydch ✦ Special Thanks to Price9317 and Lunar Pearl
skills-Rifleman-desc:
BASE:For every skill equipped in Commando branch, Assault Rifles and LMGs gain an additional 0.1 Armor Penetration.
ACE:Assault Rifle and LMG reload speed increases by 2.5% for every skill equipped in Commando branch.
skills-breaking-point-desc:
BASE:Armor Penetration for Assault Rifles and LMGs increases by 0.05 for each hit that does not penetrate an enemy's armor.
ACE:This Armor Penetration bonus increases to 0.15.
skills-HollowPointRounds-desc:
BASE:Assault Rifles and LMGs deal 15% more health damage.
ACE:Raise your health damage bonus from Assault Rifles and LMGs to 40%.
skills-HeadGames-desc:
BASE:For every skill equipped in Longshot branch, your headshot multiplier with Sniper and Marksman rifles increases by 0.1.
ACE:For each headshot you land with a Sniper or Marksman rifle, your next shot will deal 7.5% more damage.
skills-SkullTrauma-desc:
BASE:Headshots with Sniper and Marksman rifles deal 15% more damage.
ACE:Increase the reload speed of Sniper and Marksman rifles by 20%.
skills-ArmorPiercing-desc:
BASE:If you land a headshot with a Sniper or Marksman rifle that breaks an enemy's armor layer, it will remove 1 additional layer.
ACE:While aiming down sights with a Sniper or Marksman rifle, your shots will penetrate through 1 additional target.
skills-SMGAdept-desc:
BASE:For every skill equipped in Special Ops branch, SMGs deal 2% additional damage to enemy armor.
ACE:For every skill equipped in Special Ops branch, SMG spread reduces by 6%.
skills-Cracked-desc:
BASE:When you break an enemy's armor layer with an SMG, that enemy suffers 10% additional damage from all sources.
ACE:The extra damage enemies suffer when you break their armor with an SMG raises to 30%.
skills-SMGenius-desc:
BASE:When you reload an empty magazine from your SMG, gain a buff that increases SMG damage by 8%, for 10 seconds.This buff can stack up to 5 times.
ACE:The buff now stacks up to 10 times.
skills-CallingShotgun-desc:
BASE:For every skill equipped in Shotgunner branch, Shotgun pellets receive a 2.5% reduction to damage falloff.
ACE:For every skill equipped in Shotgunner branch, the spread of Shotgun pellets reduces by 3% while in ADS.
skills-PointBlank-desc:
BASE:Shotguns deal 20% additional damage to enemies within 5 meters.
ACE:Raise your Shotgun's close-range damage bonus to 50%.
skills-Annihilation-desc:
BASE:Shotguns deal 4% more damage for each pellet that hits the same target.
ACE:Increase your Shotgun's damage bonus from repeated hits to 10%.
skills-Bullseye-desc:
BASE:For every skill equipped in Hitman branch, Handguns deal 4.5% more damage to unmarked targets, or 12% more damage to marked targets.
ACE:For every skill equipped in Hitman branch, Handguns receive an accuracy bonus of 5%.
skills-CheapTrick-desc:
BASE:While you are holding a human shield and wielding a Handgun, take 40% less damage.
ACE:Shooting stunned enemies with a Handgun deals double damage.
skills-Sunburn-desc:
BASE:Enemies affected by your Flashbang Grenades take 10% more damage for every skill equipped in Flashpoint branch.
ACE:Enemies affected by your Flashbang Grenades will lose half their armor layers.
skills-ElecTenderizer-desc:
BASE:For each time a Shock Grenade blast hits the same enemy, that enemy will take 10% additional damage from all sources.
ACE:The damage bonus Shock Grenades inflict on enemies increases to 25%.
skills-HulkOut-desc:
BASE:While you have Adrenaline, gain a 2% damage bonus for every skill equipped in Imposter branch.
ACE:Your Adrenaline damage bonus increases by 5%.
skills-BulletFrenzy-desc:
BASE:Once a heister interacts with your Ammo Bag, they deal 20% more damage with primary and secondary weapons, as well as their next throwable.
ACE:Raise the damage bonus from your Ammo Bags to 50%.
skills-PremiumBag-desc:
BASE:When you deploy an Ammo Bag, all heisters within 5 meters regain 2 throwables.
ACE:Once a heister interacts with your Ammo Bag, they gain 2 Armor Penetration on the next magazine of their primary and secondary weapons.
skills-HighlyConductive-desc:
BASE:Each time a Shock Grenade blast hits an enemy, they lose 1 layer of armor for as long as they are stunned.
ACE:Enemies killed while affected by your Shock Grenade will emit an electric blast.
perk-Perk_Assassin-desc: Shots from this weapon are treated as silent
perk-Perk_Bite-desc: Whenever you do a critical hit, reduce the weapon's armor penetration by 10% of its base (down to 0%) but increase damage with 15% (max 150%) for 7 seconds. Critical hits refresh the timer.
perk-Perk_Bleed-desc: When you do health damage to an enemy you have 25% chance to affect them with bleed, causing them to take 50 damage every 2 seconds for 6 seconds.
perk-Perk_Bulky-desc: You carry and start the game with 25% less ammo for your primary and your secondary weapon, but have 10% increased armor damage resistance.
perk-Perk_ChainReact-desc: When you kill a specialist with this weapon, it triggers their equipment destruction effect. You are immune to that effect.
perk-Perk_Critter-desc: Each shot has a 2% chance to do 50% extra damage.
perk-Perk_EdgeCrit-desc: When you kill an enemy with a critical hit, you gain EDGE: deal 10% extra damage for 20s.
perk-Perk_Final-desc: The last shot in the mag deals 300% additional damage.
perk-Perk_Fool-desc: For every shot you fire, your damage increases by 4% until you stop firing.
perk-Perk_Glass-desc: You deal 15% additional base damage but take 10% increased incoming damage to your armor.
perk-Perk_GritPlate-desc: When you lose an armor plate, you gain GRIT: take 10% less damage for 20s.
perk-Perk_LeadFed-desc: Whenever you pick up ammo, you gain 10% increased damage up to maximum 25%. This effect lasts 5 seconds. The timer refreshes on ammo pickup.
perk-Perk_LuckyShot-desc: Every 4th shot deals critical hit damage.
perk-Perk_PinPuller-desc: When you use a SWAT as a human shield and shove them away, the SWAT’s smoke grenade triggers when they land. Only one grenade per SWAT can be triggered. This ability goes on a cooldown for 20 seconds.
perk-Perk_Quickshot-desc: When you kill an enemy with a critical hit, you don’t have to cycle the weapon to fire the next shot in the magazine. Reload cancels the free cycle.
perk-Perk_Resilient-desc: You take 10% less incoming damage to your armor, but deal 15% less base damage from all sources.
perk-Perk_Runner-desc: You can shoot and reload your weapons while sprinting or sliding.
perk-Perk_RushSlide-desc: When you slide, you gain RUSH: move 10% faster for 20s.
perk-Perk_Sabot-desc: 15% of damage dealt to armor is dealt directly to the enemy's HP.
perk-Perk_Sharpshooter-desc: Each critical hit increases the damage of the next shot with 15%. This effect stacks up to a maximum of 200%. If you miss a shot or hit a body part, the effect ends.
perk-Perk_Slap-desc: Meleeing a SWAT or Heavy SWAT allows you to take them as a human shield.
perk-Perk_Smith-desc: For each critical hit, gain 0.4 armor penetration until you reload the weapon (Max: 5). Each Critical Hit that penetrates armor breaks one armor layer.
perk-Perk_Superstar-desc: When you kill an enemy with a critical hit, this weapon deals 25% extra damage for 5 seconds.
perk-Perk_Threat-desc: Shooting an unsilenced weapon will shout all civilians down within 10 meter radius. Civilians are shouted down 50% longer.
perk-Perk_Trip-desc: Every shot has 50% higher chance to trigger a Stunning/medium hurt reaction. Every shot has a minimum chance of 10% to trigger a stunning hurt reaction.
perk-Perk_Vampire-desc: When you deal damage with this weapon you recover 0.5% of your health. This also gives you adrenaline.
perk-Perk_Veteran-desc: When you kill an enemy, you have 15% chance to immediately add the dropped ammo into the magazine. Excess ammo goes into the ammo inventory.
perk-Perk_WestWood-desc: When killing an enemy, other enemies within 3 meters of that enemy lose 15% accuracy for 3s. This effect stacks to a maximum of 90%.
